mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5%, signaling aggressive monetary tightening, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5%, or correlation coefficient < -0.3 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), a tightening labor market fuels wage pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or the mechanism's Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month decline in INDPRO, indicating weakening supply chain activity, precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as reduced production hints at slowing economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in decline periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always, RSAFS growth outpacing HOUST by more than 10% YoY signals robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of instances when RSAFS outpaces HOUST by > 10% YoY, or mechanism's Rank IC < 0.025 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds its 6-month moving average by more than 2%, indicating rising inflation pressures, investors anticipate tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or correlation coefficient < -0.35 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, a UNRATE below 4% with simultaneously rising PAYEMS signals a strong labor market, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer spending power.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS rises, or mechanism's Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO and HOUST jointly decline over a 3-month period, signaling synchronized supply chain and housing market weakness, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 trading days due to anticipated economic slowdown.
candidate_trigger: 3-month joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2.5-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in joint decline periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
